image_description: A close-up portrait of a mature male orangutan resting its chin on its arms, which are draped over a mossy rock. The subject features characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and prominent cheek pads (flanges). The background consists of blurred rocks and foliage, with out-of-focus green leaves in the immediate foreground creating a depth-of-field effect.
